claims.statement: Elastic documents a token-service access token, issued by the get-token API, that is short-lived (20 minutes by default, at most 1 hour) and used as a bearer token in the Authorization header.

sources.supports: The access token is a short-lived token. By default, it expires after 20 minutes but it can be configured to last a maximum of 1 hour. The access token is a bearer token.

openQuestions.question: The access token value grammar is not documented in the pages read; as an opaque short-lived value it must not be attributed to Elastic from generic shape.
This candidate is recorded from the claims above only; format, variants, history and benign siblings have not been researched.
